name: empty
title: Empty
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Empty: a 2px solid frame (dashes mean disabled in this kit), title in lettering, media in an ink frame. Adds EmptyMark, a heavy ellipsis that pops in.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/empty". It wraps your own components/ui/empty, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: An empty panel with a heavy “…”.
meta.usage:
import { Empty, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMark, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/ui/manga/empty"

<Empty>
  <EmptyHeader>
    <EmptyMark />
    <EmptyTitle>No bookmarks</EmptyTitle>
    <EmptyDescription>Tap the corner of a page to keep it.</EmptyDescription>
  </EmptyHeader>
</Empty>
